headings.usage: H1, H2, Magical Answers, Oracle Output, Tarot Card Names. Highly decorative for the esoteric feel.

ui_body.usage: Buttons, Labels, Paragraphs, Tabs, App Navigation, Stats.

spacing_system.gap: 16px between list items or grid elements

glassmorphism.description: Apply to all cards, modals, and the Bottom Navigation bar to create a frosted cosmic glass effect.

glowing_orbs.primary: Radial gradient using #9D4EDD (neon purple) fading to transparent, overlaid with heavy blur.

layout.app_shell: Bottom Navigation Bar with 4 tabs (Главная, Оракул, Таро, Дневник). Preferred floating glassmorphism style.
layout.cards: Subtle border, inner glow, dark transparent background.
layout.screen_container: Full height, hidden scrollbars, dark #0D0E15 base color.

reanimated_suggestions.description: Interpolate rotateY from 0deg to 180deg with spring physics (damping & stiffness) to reveal the card front.
Use withRepeat and withTiming on scale (1 to 1.1) and opacity to create a slow, mystical breathing effect.
Use react-native-gesture-handler Swipeable. Left swipe reveals green check for 'Сбылось' (Came true). Right swipe reveals red cross for 'Не сбылось' (Didn't come true).
Fade in with a slight vertical slide (translateY) using ease-out timing.

backgrounds.description: Deep space cosmic starfield. Apply strong dark overlay (#0D0E15 at 80% opacity) so text remains readable.

orbs.description: Glowing mystical neon orb reference to be used as a central interactive element in the Oracle tab.

tarot.description: Tarot cards arrangement image to use in headers or spread mode background.
Background or placeholder image for the active Tarot draw mode.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST use data-testid. Examples: data-testid="tab-home", data-testid="btn-draw-card", data-testid="oracle-input", data-testid="diary-swipe-true".

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a mobile app (React Native with Expo). Use Expo's BlurView (or similar) to achieve glassmorphism since standard CSS backdrop-filter does not work natively on mobile views without a wrapper. For all text in Russian, ensure the fonts Cormorant Garamond and Manrope load Cyrillic character sets via expo-google-fonts. Adhere strictly to the #0D0E15 dark background. Gold (#D4AF37) is your primary action color, while Neon Purple (#9D4EDD) should be used for mystical radial background glows and active states. Build the 4 requested tabs exactly as specified.
